headline: China's Xi calls for step up of global effort in AI, as US curbs squeeze China's tech access
context: American-led restrictions have blocked China from accessing some of the world's most advanced technologies, spurring China's efforts to build its own know-how and intensifying the tech race between the world's two biggest economies.

sources.name: NPR
